channel.title: Los Angeles News Group - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles News Group (losangelesnewsgroup.com)

item.title: Dead whale washed up in Newport Beach near 11th Street
item.description: The 30-foot whale, believed to be a humpback, came onto shore at about 3 p.m. between the Newport and Balboa piers

item.title: Malibu sues state, LA city, county over Palisades fire
item.description: The lawsuit contends that the Palisades fire — which erupted Jan. 7, 2025, in what investigators contend was a flare-up of a blaze known as the Lachman fire that began a week earlier — killed at least six Malibu residents and destroyed 700 homes and dozens of businesses in the city.

item.title: Why a dose of art may be the cure for a number of society’s ailments
item.description: Dr. Daisy Fancourt's new book 'Art Cure: The Science of How the Arts Save Lives' examines the research behind art as a form of medicine.

item.title: DOJ is seeking to join lawsuit alleging LAUSD bias against White students
item.description: The US Justice Department is seeking to join a lawsuit challenging LAUSD's PHBAO program, which plaintiffs allege provides additional staffing and magnet admission priority to schools designated as predominantly non-white.

item.title: Fired woman to get deposition of Curren Price deputy chief of staff
item.description: The District Attorney's Office charged Price in June 2023 with multiple felony charges of grand theft by embezzlement, conflict of interest and perjury.

item.title: California’s proposed billionaire tax brings Sen. Bernie Sanders to rally in LA
item.description: The progressive senator's decision to wade into the debate signals how the tax proposal is figuring into national conversations about wealth and government services.

item.title: USC men have no answer for No. 10 Illinois in their most lopsided loss of season
item.description: The Fighting Illini open a 22-point lead by halftime and pour it on in the second half to hand the Trojans a 101-65 defeat at the Galen Center. Ezra Ausar has 15 points and 11 rebounds to pace USC.

item.title: Sierra Canyon girls basketball finds a way past Centennial in Open playoffs
item.description: Sierra Canyon trails in the fourth quarter but gets a spark from its bench to pull out a win and move on to the quarterfinals.

item.title: Troy girls basketball falls to Valencia in the Division 1 quarterfinals
item.description: L.A. County's Valencia takes the lead in the final minute and brings an end to Kevin Kiernan's first season back at Troy.

item.title: Woman faces up to 10 years in prison for fatal DUI crash in West Hills
item.description: Carol Singer, 76, was killed in the crash in 2022.
